personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines and proven methods, while also being somewhat disorganized and likely to change plans on the fly. They usually prefer quiet, solitary time or very small groups, and they may need extra time to warm up in social settings. When faced with moral dilemmas, they try hard to protect harmony and avoid hurting anyone, often empathizing strongly with all sides, but their anxiety can make them overthink the consequences and hesitate to decide. In group discussions, they speak cautiously and softly, listen more than they talk, and often choose agreeable wording to prevent conflict even when they feel stressed inside.
